title: Mila Calcifer continues the Interview

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: So you chatted with my dad again huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you chatted with my dad again huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Well I am pleased to say you have made the final shortlist of candidates. You have an excellent chance of being Mr Gospodin's friend and/or romantic partner. Can I confirm this is still what you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I am pleased to say you have made the final shortlist of candidates. You have an excellent chance of being Mr Gospodin's friend and/or romantic partner. Can I confirm this is still what you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like Garnet and I'd like to see where things go romantically.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like Garnet and I'd like to see where things go romantically.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like Garnet and I'd like to see where things go romantically.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like Garnet and I'd like to see where things go romantically.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like Garnet but just as a friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like Garnet but just as a friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like Garnet but just as a friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like Garnet but just as a friend.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Really? I'm... excited to see where this development leads. I understand. You have one more task to complete for your final assessment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? I'm... excited to see where this development leads. I understand. You have one more task to complete for your final assessment.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I understand. Then you have one more task to complete for your final assessment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand. Then you have one more task to complete for your final assessment.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Mr Gospodin - my father - often cooks me dinner after a long shift driving his taxi cab. When he comes home, and when I am asleep, I often hear noises from the adjoining room. Our apartment has terrible soundproofing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr Gospodin - my father - often cooks me dinner after a long shift driving his taxi cab. When he comes home, and when I am asleep, I often hear noises from the adjoining room. Our apartment has terrible soundproofing.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Oh, you know. Just single-dad noises.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you know. Just single-dad noises.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Single dad noises?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Single dad noises?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: The noise a single dad makes who has not quite come to terms with the sudden death of his wife six years ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The noise a single dad makes who has not quite come to terms with the sudden death of his wife six years ago.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh Mila...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh Mila...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...What kind of noises?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...What kind of noises?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: He cries every night. How would you rectify this situation and fix him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He cries every night. How would you rectify this situation and fix him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No one can fix him Mila. He needs to grieve.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No one can fix him Mila. He needs to grieve.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No one can fix him Mila. He needs to grieve.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No one can fix him Mila. He needs to grieve.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: That is... a most satisfactory answer. Yes, very good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That is... a most satisfactory answer. Yes, very good.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Please save your own questions for the end. I have more questions of my own. Important ones.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please save your own questions for the end. I have more questions of my own. Important ones.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I won't hurt him. And I'm not going anywhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I won't hurt him. And I'm not going anywhere.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I won't hurt him. And I'm not going anywhere.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I won't hurt him. And I'm not going anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Very good. Then I am pleased to say that I can now offer you the position of Mr Garnet Gospodin's newest social contact with upgrade potential to romantic partner. Best of luck in this new position.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very good. Then I am pleased to say that I can now offer you the position of Mr Garnet Gospodin's newest social contact with upgrade potential to romantic partner. Best of luck in this new position.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can I do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can I do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go ahead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go ahead.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Will you hurt him? And will you leave us?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will you hurt him? And will you leave us?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: There is just one additional fact I must make you aware of.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is just one additional fact I must make you aware of.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hmm... what's that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm... what's that?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Mr Gospodin, though feeling much better of late, has gone through a... rough patch. As such, he may not be ready for an intimate relationship right now. Not for a while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr Gospodin, though feeling much better of late, has gone through a... rough patch. As such, he may not be ready for an intimate relationship right now. Not for a while.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks Mila.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks Mila.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He cries every night?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He cries every night?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you ok?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: His wife... my mother... was a very special person. An exemplary woman. My dad might need you to... go slow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His wife... my mother... was a very special person. An exemplary woman. My dad might need you to... go slow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Oh, and if you see him, tell him I left him some pizza for after his shift. The good kind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, and if you see him, tell him I left him some pizza for after his shift. The good kind.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Are you kidding? No! Of course not. But it does have capers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you kidding? No! Of course not. But it does have capers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Delicious!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Delicious!

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Exactly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: See you around Mila.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See you around Mila.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I hope so. Really... I mean it. It will take dad a long time to come around. He's pretty fragile. But... I think one day we'll split a pizza with you. If you wanted that. And then... I guess see how you feel about him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope so. Really... I mean it. It will take dad a long time to come around. He's pretty fragile. But... I think one day we'll split a pizza with you. If you wanted that. And then... I guess see how you feel about him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: With real cheese?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With real cheese?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure thing Mila.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure thing Mila.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It just takes time Mila. Be there for him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It just takes time Mila. Be there for him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It just takes time Mila. Be there for him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It just takes time Mila. Be there for him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know how to fix him Mila. But we can both try our best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know how to fix him Mila. But we can both try our best.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know how to fix him Mila. But we can both try our best.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know how to fix him Mila. But we can both try our best.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I won't hurt either of you. And I'll be there as long as you both want me around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I won't hurt either of you. And I'll be there as long as you both want me around.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I won't hurt either of you. And I'll be there as long as you both want me around.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I won't hurt either of you. And I'll be there as long as you both want me around.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gross.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gross.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Now we're talking, what kind?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now we're talking, what kind?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: It does have capers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It does have capers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure I wanna know ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure I wanna know ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure I wanna know ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure I wanna know ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Always one up your sleeves, kid?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Always one up your sleeves, kid?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Always one up your sleeves, kid?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Always one up your sleeves, kid?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We'll find out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We'll find out.
